Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.

translations.web: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.
translations.bsb: Mocker is the name of the proud and arrogant man— of him who acts with excessive pride.
translations.kjv: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.
translations.asv: The proud and haughty man, scoffer is his name; He worketh in the arrogance of pride.
